utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning to everyone. The Court is in session. Mr. Registrar, could you please call the case, please. Madam Registrar, I'm sorry.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-98-32/1-A, the Prosecutor versus Milan Lukic and Sredoje Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I see that Mr. Milan Lukic is not in the courtroom today. Milan Lukic's counsel, do you have any arguments to put forward relating to this matter?

utterances.speaker: MR. IVETIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, thank you. First of all, good morning, Your Honour. Dan Ivetic appearing for Mr. Milan Lukic. And I would just like to advise the Chamber that my client will not be attending today's status hearing in light of some continuing concerns and difficulties that he is experiencing in regards to the new transport method from UNDU to the Tribunal. These concerns have been previously communicated to the relevant authorities, so I will not repeat them here. And it is my understanding, which I have confirmed, that a written waiver of his appearance has been executed by my client and that we may therefore proceed with today's hearing without any problems in his absence. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much for the explanation. We have the written consent, I think, on this respect. In addition to that, it is always possible, according to the Rules 80, 81 of the Rules governing the detention to file a request for complaint to the Commanding Officer and if necessary to the Registrar. Having said that, we can resume our hearing in the absence of Milan Lukic. Mr. Sredoje Lukic, are you able to follow the proceedings in a language you understand? THE APPELLANT SREDOJE LUKIC: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much. [Interpretation] You may sit down. I would like to have the appearances now, please. The OTP first, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President. Peter Kremer and Matthew Gillett appearing on behalf of the Prosecution, with our Case Manager, Colin Nawrot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much. [Interpretation] Let me now turn to Defence counsel of Mr. Milan Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. IVETIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour, again. Dan Ivetic appearing on behalf of Milan Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let me now turn to Defence counsel of Mr. Sredoje Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. On behalf of the Sredoje Lukic Defence team, myself, Djuro Cepic as Defence counsel. Appearing with me, my learned friend Mr. Jens Dieckmann as a co-counsel. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This Status Conference has been convened pursuant to Rule 65 bis (B) and (C) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of this Tribunal that require a Status Conference to be held within 120 days of the filing of a Notice of Appeal and thereafter, within 120 days after the last Status Conference. The main focus of a Status Conference is to allow any person in custody pending appeal the opportunity to raise issues relating thereto including the mental and physical condition of that person. This is the sixth Status Conference to be convened in the appeals proceedings in this case. The last Status Conference was held on March 10th, 2011. The Appeals Chamber has already issued two decisions yesterday regarding the first and second motion seeking to adduce further evidence and filed by Milan Lukic. The decisions pertaining to the other motions pursuant to Rule 115 and filed by Milan Lukic will be issued in due course before the appeals hearings. Lastly, the appeals hearings will be held on September 14th and 15th, 2011. A Scheduling Order will be issued today. It will specify the times of the hearings and the time allocated to each party for their oral submissions. As regards the questions suggested to the parties by the Bench, these will be addressed in a separate order which will be issued in due course. I would now like to turn to Milan Lukic and Milan Lukic's Defence counsel and Sredoje Lukic to inquire into their state of health and conditions of detention. Let me first turn to Milan Lukic's Defence counsel. Did Milan Lukic share with you any concerns he may have as regards his conditions of detention or his state of health?

utterances.speaker: MR. IVETIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, it's my understanding that everything, the status quo from the last status hearing, remains, that he has not communicated any new concerns relative to his detention.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much. [Interpretation] Let me now turn to Mr. Sredoje Lukic. Do you wish to share with the Bench any concerns you may have regarding your conditions of detention or your state of health? THE APPELLANT SREDOJE LUKIC: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour, for allowing me to speak. I am quite pleased with my treatment at the UNDU, and my health is quite good.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. You may sit down. I would lastly like to ask the parties whether at this stage they have any questions they wish to raise during the Status Conference. Let me first turn to the representatives of the OTP.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. We have no further issues. You've answered all of our concerns earlier in your remarks. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you very much. [Interpretation] Milan Lukic's Defence counsel, I'm turning to you. Do you wish to raise any particular issue?

utterances.speaker: MR. IVETIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, we have no other issues to raise with you this morning. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let me now turn to Mr. Sredoje Lukic's Defence counsel. Do you wish to raise any particular issue at this stage?

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour, for this opportunity. At this moment the only problem for our Defence team is that Professor Knoops is occupied on 14th and 15th of September, but I will try to solve that issue with him as soon as this Status Conference will be completed. Any other issues there is no reason to raise from our side at this moment. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I hope you will be able to solve the problems you are faced with in the near future. As far as I'm concerned, I have no further issue to raise. I believe, therefore, that we can adjourn today's hearing. I would like to thank the parties for their attendance and the staff of the Tribunal for their help in organising this conference. The hearing stands adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 10.16 a.m.
